page_title: BAR 1-0 PAL | Barcelona v Las Palmas 30/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' The total number of attempts is 14:8.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) is punished with the yellow card.
86' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the right post.
84' A cross into the box from Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) is cleared.
83' The resulting set piece from Barcelona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Vitor Roque (Barcelona) replaces Robert Lewandowski.
81' Substitution. Oriol Romeu (Barcelona) has come on for Sergi Roberto.
81' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
78' That will be all from Sergi Cardona who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas).
78' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to substitute Sandro Ramirez and he is replaced by Marc Cardona (Las Palmas).
78' Joao Felix (Barcelona) picks up a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot goalwards that crashes against the bar. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
72' A substitution has been made. Javier Munoz is replaced by Jose Campana (Las Palmas).
71' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Enzo Loiodice.
71' Oscar Hernandez prepares a substitution. Lamine Yamal is replaced by Ferran Torres (Barcelona).
69' Wonderful movement by Barcelona. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
66' A cross from Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
64' Inigo Martinez (Barcelona) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
63' Sergi Roberto (Barcelona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mateo Busquets Ferrer had an easy-decision to make.

59' 1 - 0 Joao Felix sends a superb cross into the box. Raphinha (Barcelona) latches on to it and from close range plants a header into the top left corner, leaving Aaron Escandell beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 1:0.
59' Las Palmas are ruled offside.
56' Barcelona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
56' It will be a substitution. Joao Felix (Barcelona) is ready to enter the pitch as Fermin Lopez walks off.
54' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) sends a long ball in, but Aaron Escandell comfortably gathers the ball.
53' Raphinha (Barcelona) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
51' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
50' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
49' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Sergi Roberto (Barcelona) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
47' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+5' Barcelona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
45+4' The corner is swung in but Barcelona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
45+3' Inigo Martinez (Barcelona) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
44' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
42' The number of shots on goal at present is 1:0.
40' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.

38' Barcelona slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
35' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
32' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
29' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Barcelona.
28' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Munir El Haddadi departs the field of play to be replaced by Aaron Escandell (Las Palmas).
24' Alvaro Valles (Las Palmas) must think that he is playing a different sport because his behaviour has nothing to do with football and the referee has no choice but to show him a straight red card!
23' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
21' The goal by Barcelona is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
20' The Barcelona players halt their celebrations as referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
19' Goal! 1:0. The ball rebounds to Raphinha (Barcelona) after a melee in the box, and he easily beats the keeper from close range.
17' Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) rises above the defence to meet the corner. His timing is good, but he arrows his header just a few inches wide of the right post.
17' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Barcelona.
14' Mateo Busquets Ferrer shows a yellow card to Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) for his blatant foul.
13' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked.
11' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
9' Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Mateo Busquets Ferrer has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
8' Marvin (Las Palmas) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
5' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
2' Las Palmas take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Las Palmas will have the kick-off.
Mateo Busquets Ferrer got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
